title: C04: nonzero smeared field corollary for the C16 endpoint (refs #251)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #251

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/251#issuecomment-6863820811, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-2f29`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026, package C04: `manuscript/existence/boundary-detection.tex`; `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/{ledger.md, correspondence.md, nonzero-field-20261113.md}`
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent for @ADB991. No other agents.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

The public target `ex-reconstructed` requires that at least one smeared field be nonzero (`Reconstructed.acts`). C04 proved only that every nonzero label gives a nonzero field. With E = {0} all its hypotheses hold and every field vanishes, so a nonzero label was missing. This was review M3 and finding F3 of the endpoint check in PR #248.

This PR adds, after `prop:boundary-detection`:
- `input:unit-insertion`: for one grade d₀, a raw label **1** whose insertion obeys the unit law S(**1**,v₁,…,vₙ; x₀,…,xₙ) = S(v₁,…,vₙ; x₁,…,xₙ) in the **unselected** limiting correlations, together with S(∅) = 1;
- `cor:nonzero-field`, with a full proof. If **1** were null, the one-point word would give 0 = S(**1**; x₀) = S(∅) = 1. So its class is nonzero, and its union image u is nonzero by the injectivity that `prop:boundary-detection` already assumes. The contrapositive of `prop:boundary-detection` and the field formula of `prop:word-fields` then give Φ(u,f) ≠ 0.

This is the source's route: `YM.Table.alive` → `YM.Table.pin_inj` → faithfulness, in `HierarchyBridge.publicReconstruction`. No existing statement changed.

**Still open.** The new input E6 has no producer in the manuscript. `prop:ex-limits-euclidean` covers normalization but not the unit law. The proposed owner is the C03 limits author. I did not check how the finite-lattice unit insertion is defined, so passing the identity to the limit is a proposal only. In the source, `S.Basic` is part of the premise `Seed.kernel`. E4 and F1 (PR #203) are untouched.

  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode` on `manuscript/existence.tex`: exit 0, 983 pages, no undefined references. I inspected rendered page 198, which holds Input 48.6 and Corollary 48.7.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration (text-only correspondence; Mathlib sources are not reachable from this sandbox). No search for literature, since the argument is elementary.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: new C04 output `cor:nonzero-field` and new input E6, both in the C04 ledger. The C04-to-C16-endpoint row is updated. No C16 change is needed: rule (T) of PR #248 transports Φ(u,f) ≠ 0 to the public field. Editing `boundary-detection.tex` changes the content hash of a YM-000026 file.
